svg.title: Hi, I’m Amit Tiwari — Senior Full-Stack .NET Engineer
svg.desc: Animated hero panel in a hot-rod red and gold heads-up-display style: a terminal types ./suit-up --profile, the name Amit Tiwari glows, roles cycle (Senior Full-Stack .NET Engineer, Azure Cloud Specialist, AI Plugin Builder, Microsoft Certified Solution Developer), stat chips show 14+ years, 6 certifications, 6 awards and open to freelance; on the right Amit’s illustrated avatar sits inside rotating HUD rings with a target-lock reticle and system readouts.

text.tspan: Engineering cloud-native, AI-powered systems on .NET & Azure —
secure, observable, and built to last.
